units.source_text: 像怪谲野兽般吸住人的沙子。

en.t: Sand that clung to people like some uncanny beast.

units.source_text: 他拖着步子，好容易才在黑暗中摸索到了门口。

en.t: He dragged his feet and, only with great effort, groped his way through the darkness to the doorway.

units.source_text: 他把脱了铰链的采集箱，摸索着轻轻放到地炉的边上。

en.t: Groping in the dark, he gently set the collecting box with its hinges off beside the sunken hearth.

units.source_text: 天空中呜呜呼啸着风声。

en.t: Overhead, the wind howled and wailed.

units.source_text: 他从地炉的角落里，掏出塑料袋裹着的火柴，点上了灯。

en.t: From a corner of the sunken hearth, he took out the matches wrapped in a plastic bag and lit the lamp.
